import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXK = 31;
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = readNumber(sc);
        int base = (int) readNumber(sc);
        final int MAX_BASE = 70;

        // Read digits of n in the given base
        int[] digits = new int[70];
        int len = 0;
        long tempN = n;
        while (tempN > 0) {
            digits[len++] = (int) (tempN % base);
            tempN /= base;
        }

        long[][][] A = new long[MAX_BASE][MAXK][MAXK];
        long[][] pre = new long[MAXK][MAXK];
        long[][] suf = new long[MAXK][MAXK];
        long[][] ans = new long[MAXK][MAXK];
        long[][] I = new long[MAXK][MAXK];

        // Initialize identity matrix
        makeIdentity(I, base + 1);

        // Setup matrices
        setupMatrices(A, pre, suf, I, base, len);

        // Initialize answer matrix
        long[][] answer = new long[MAXK][MAXK];
        for (int i = 0; i <= base; i++) {
            answer[i][0] = (i == 0) ? 1 : 0;
        }

        long x = 0;
        for (int i = len - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            int digit = digits[i];
            for (int j = 0; j < digit; j++) {
                matrixProduct(A[i][(int)((j + x) % base)], answer, answer, base);
            }
            x = (x + digit) % base;
        }

        long res = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < base; i++) {
            res = (res + answer[i][0]) % MOD;
        }
        System.out.println(res + 1);
        sc.close();
    }

    static long readNumber(Scanner sc) {
        String s = sc.next();
        long res = 0;
        boolean negative = false;
        int index = 0;
        if (s.charAt(0) == '-') {
            negative = true;
            index = 1;
        }
        for (; index < s.length(); index++) {
            res = res * 10 + (s.charAt(index) - '0');
        }
        return negative ? -res : res;
    }

    static void makeIdentity(long[][] I, int size) {
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < size; j++) {
                I[i][j] = (i == j) ? 1 : 0;
            }
        }
    }

    static void setupMatrices(long[][][] A, long[][] pre, long[][] suf, long[][] I, int base, int len) {
        // Initialize A[0]
        for (int i = 0; i < base; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= base; j++) {
                A[0][i][j] = 0;
            }
            A[0][i][i] = 1;
            A[0][i][0] = 1;
        }

        for (int i = 1; i < len; i++) {
            // Copy previous A
            for (int j = 0; j < base; j++) {
                System.arraycopy(A[i - 1][0], 0, pre[0], 0, base);
            }
            // Build pre
            for (int j = 1; j < base; j++) {
                matrixProduct(A[i - 1][j], pre[j - 1], pre[j], base);
            }
            // Build suf
            System.arraycopy(A[i - 1][base - 1], 0, suf[base - 1], 0, base);
            for (int j = base - 2; j >= 0; j--) {
                matrixProduct(suf[j + 1], A[i - 1][j], suf[j], base);
            }
            // Build A[i][j]
            for (int j = 0; j < base; j++) {
                if (j > 0) {
                    matrixProduct(pre[j - 1], suf[j], A[i][j], base);
                } else {
                    matrixProduct(I, suf[j], A[i][j], base);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void matrixProduct(long[][] A, long[][] B, long[][] R, int base) {
        int size = base;
        long[][] C = new long[size][size];
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < size; j++) {
                C[i][j] = 0;
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            for (int k = 0; k < size; k++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < size; j++) {
                    C[i][j] = (C[i][j] + A[i][k] * B[k][j]) % MOD;
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            System.arraycopy(C[i], 0, R[i], 0, size);
        }
    }
}
